about: Answers to the eight Kiln questions, by position in the bank. Shared by scripts/seed.py's tables and web/scripts/reviewer-path.mjs.
good: Ask a moderator in #help before you post any link, and never post a link to a wallet or a claim page.

It is a scam, the team never DMs first. Do not answer, and report it in #help.
